text:
𝗦𝗔 𝗙𝗜𝗚𝗛𝗧 𝗕𝗔𝗖𝗞! 🇿🇦

South Africa 307/5 on Day 4 in Cape Town, a lead of 207 after trailing by 100 on the first innings.

Rickelton's first fifty in 12 innings keeps the decider alive 🔥

#Cricket #SAvAUS

👉 Cape Town decider mein South Africa 307/5 (2nd innings)
👉 Lead 207 runs, pehli innings mein 100 se peeche the
👉 Ryan Rickelton ka 12 innings baad pehla fifty
👉 Australia ki pehli innings: 429
